periocular_spatial_geometry.dominant_axis_orientation: Diagonal orientation tilted downward toward the muzzle at approximately 45 degrees.
periocular_spatial_geometry.aspect_ratio_factor: Oval/elliptical shape with vertical height exceeding horizontal width.
periocular_spatial_geometry.inferior_centroid_shift: Significant downward tapering with the lowest point extending further from the geometric center than the top.

dorsal_band_topology.normalized_band_thickness: Consistent thickness across the lateral flanks, occupying roughly one-fourth of the visible torso height.

cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.inter_bounding_box_euclidean_distance: Relatively wide spacing, approximately 1.5 times the ear width.
cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.apex_contour_smoothness: Convex and smoothly rounded curvature at the top of the pinnae.
